Class MarketSimulator

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.model.gameEngine.strategies.marketsimulator.MarketSimulator
All Implemented Interfaces:
PriceStrategy
public class MarketSimulator extends Object implements PriceStrategy
Java translation of the Cookie Clicker bank minigame's stock price advancement logic (M.calculateNewPrice).
